_comment: DATA-384, amended by DATA-410 (Carter's ruling 2026-10-07, corrected by the lead): which source record_intention gets, by whose words the text is. The contract for the rule in _record_intention.py SOURCE_RULE / DRAFT_RULE and for the examples in skills/record-intention/SKILL.md "## Source", which are the rows with a skill line, in this order. said: what the resident said or wrote (for background, what a memory pass read). kind: own-words | asks-agent-to-write | yes-after-capture | quoted | confirms-quoted | translated | setup | note | inferred | background | confirms-draft | edits-draft | declines-draft | unanswered-draft | go-ahead. where: conversation | onboarding | note | background. draft: the agent's own words it shows with the one ask "Should I publish this as written?" (the ask kinds: it records nothing yet) or showed before `said` (the answer kinds: confirms-, edits-, declines-, unanswered-draft); null when nothing is asked. text: what the agent records. source: the source the rule gives, or null when nothing is recorded now (text is then null too). confirmed_in_chat: yes | silence | standing on a message capture of the agent's words the resident adopted, else null. held: the tool's answer is a hold for the resident's tap on the approval card (ambient, and silence, whose capture is made from the agent's own cron send: held_cron), false when it publishes, null when nothing is recorded. why: the reason. skill: the example line in SKILL.md, or null. Checked by plugins/av-events/tests/test_intention_source.py; no model runs.
